statement: Within the newborn cord-care product and guidance set reviewed, offerings are clinical/educational (alcohol-free dry care, drying sprays, kits, hospital handouts) and none was found to help a mother navigate family/elder pressure to apply traditional substances or outdated alcohol wiping; within that reviewed set the emotional-relational dimension is unserved.
evidence: Reviewed set = clinical info pages (BabyCenter, Cloudnine, Merck, hospital handouts, WHO ENC) plus a few drying-spray/kits items (a pediatrician-recommended drying spray referenced in r/newborns). None of the reviewed material addresses navigating the grandmother/MIL dimension that recurs in customer threads (see CRF-PPL-CORD-CARE-004/005).
scan_coverage_note: Scan coverage: reviewed English-web newborn cord-care product/guidance pages (BabyCenter, Cloudnine, Merck, WHO Essential Newborn Care, hospital handouts) and a drying-spray item referenced in r/newborns, plus cord-care discussion on r/newborns and r/beyondthebump (see CRF-PPL-CORD-CARE-004/005). NOT scanned: paid ad catalogs, non-English and offline community marketplaces (Nairaland was CAPTCHA-blocked), Facebook groups, and Nigeria/Ghana retail shelves. The absence observation is limited to the reviewed set.
source: r/newborns drying-spray comment; BabyCenter/Cloudnine/Merck/WHO ENC; CRF-PPL-CORD-CARE-004/005
